questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a natural pesticide?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rotenone**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rotenone** is an example of a **natural pesticide.**
 
• **Rotenone **is used as a **pesticide, insecticide**, and as** nonselective piscicide.**
 
• It is a naturally occurring complex ketone, derived from the roots of the Lonchocarpus species.
 
• It is a commonly used pesticide and is also used in lakes and reservoirs to kill fish that are perceived as pests.

questions.question: Which of the following has the same dimension as pressure?

__
 
• **Stress is developed in a body** when it is **subjected to a deforming force**.
 
• An opposite and equal force develops in response to the force applied.
 
• The restoring force per unit area of a body is called **stress**. The restoring force is equal to and the opposite of the deforming force applied to the body. It can also be defined as the deforming force per unit area of the body.
 
• So it has the same dimensions as that of pressure **(force/area). **
 
• **Dimension of Pressure and Stress: **M L⁻¹ T⁻²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Strain**__** **

 __
 
• It is the **result of stress** experienced by the body.
 
• It may be observed in the **form of physical deformation** undergone by the body.
 
• It can be measured as the ratio of change in dimension to the original dimension.
 
• So it is **unitless**.
 
 
 
• **Work**__
 __
 
• It is a measure of energy expended to move an object over a certain distance.
 
• It is expressed as the **product of the force**(required to move the object) **and the displacement.**
 
• So its dimensions are **ML²T⁻²**.
 
 
 
• **Force**__** **
 
 
• In physics, a force is an influence that can change the motion of an object. 
 
• It is an external agent that results in a change in the state(rest or motion) of an object.
 
• It is expressed as the **product of mass**(of the object under change of state) **and acceleration** (of the object during the change).
 
• So its dimensions are **MLT⁻².**

questions.solution:

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Spongilla is a freshwater sponge.
 
• It is a member of the family Spongillidae.
 
• It is generally found in lakes, ponds, and slow streams.
 
• Sponges belong to the phylum Porifera. They are generally marine and mostly asymmetrical animals.
 
• These are primitive multicellular animals and have a cellular level of organization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sponges have a water transport or canal system. Water enters through minute pores (ostia) in the body wall into a central cavity, spongocoel, from where it goes out through the osculum.
 
• This pathway of water transport is helpful in food gathering, respiratory exchange, and removal of waste. Choanocytes or collar cells line the spongocoel and the canals.
 
• Digestion is intracellular. The body is supported by a skeleton made up of spicules or spongin fibres.
 
• Sexes are not separate (hermaphrodite), i.e., eggs and sperms are produced by the same individual.
 
• Sponges reproduce asexually by fragmentation and sexually by the formation of gametes.
 
• Fertilization is internal and development is indirect having a larval stage that is morphologically distinct from the adult.
